name: Goldleaf's Discovery
label: Quest
description: Goldleaf's Discovery: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, Aurel Goldleaf thinks she's found a way to summon and defeat a ruling member of the Abyssal Council! Such a task will be dangerous, but you have earned great respect amongst the Cenarion Circle. We know that if anyone can do it, you can.
May fortune go with you, friend. Speak with Aurel when you are ready.

clips.title: Completion
paras: What Huum says is true. I believe I know how to summon a lord of the Abyssal Council! Listen on, and I will explain...
